content.short: MintMatrix is professional-grade infrastructure for digital asset management and RWA tokenization on Cardano.
content.description: MintMatrix is a sophisticated infrastructure project on Cardano dedicated to developing frictionless financial tools for the digital era. Drawing on expertise in aerospace flight software and complex systems, the team provides institutional-grade solutions for asset tokenization, including real estate, vehicles, and physical art. The platform features a suite of smart contract instruments for asset fracturing, amortized transfers, and collateralized bonding. With an integrated Digital Identity Console for secure KYC, MintMatrix enables businesses and individuals to digitize and manage capital.
content.meta: MintMatrix provides Cardano infrastructure for asset tokenization, RWA management, and digital identity. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
